history.summary: 99-yr leasehold 1BR at Archipelago, a large D16 (Bedok Reservoir) development 680m from DT29 Bedok North, asking $888,888 at $1,333 PSF for 667 sqft. Strong 150-txn URA base gives a highly reliable 7.06%/yr rate, and PSF is ~19% under the $1,638 median.
history.rating_rationale: The standout liquidity profile of the batch: 150 URA txns make the 7.06%/yr appreciation credible (not a thin-data illusion), it's a large development (deep buyer pool), efficient 667 sqft 1BR, sub-$900k entry, and DTL connectivity. PSF discount to median plus reliable above-baseline appreciation is a genuinely good investment setup. Leasehold and 2015 build are minor offsets.

catalysts: TEL + Bayshore precinct development in Upper East Coast

history.summary: Genuinely-cheap 667sqft 1BR at a well-built UOL/SingLand resort-style D16 development; asking PSF verifiably sits below the project's own recent transactions, in an OCR location the v3.4 prior favours.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,332 psf is real value: verified Archipelago transactions over the past 12 months averaged ~$1,457-1,504 psf (range ~$1,103-1,701), so the -22.1% age-adj cheapness is corroborated, not a single-comp artifact. Developer is UOL Group + Singapore Land (strong build quality, well-maintained, responsive MC per reviews); 2015 completion leaves ~88 yrs lease. D16 (OCR) carries the better realized forward return (~+4.0%) under the v3.4 region prior. The 7.06% 5yr CAGR (150 txns) is robust enough to be a real story but I weight it only lightly per backtest. Main caveats: 667sqft is large for a '1BR' (likely 1+study, slightly oddly-positioned for pure rental yield), and the size-cohort behind the -17.6% psf-vs-cohort figure is thin (only 2 txns), so the precise cohort discount is less reliable than the project-level cheapness.
red_flags: psf_cohort_txns of only 2 makes the -17.6% same-size discount statistically thin
667sqft is oversized for a 1BR (likely 1+study), narrowing the tenant/buyer pool vs a compact 1BR
Bedok Reservoir location is not directly MRT-adjacent (walk to Bedok Reservoir MRT)
catalysts: Asking PSF below the project's own verified 12-month transaction average leaves room to exit at market
OCR/East rental demand and resort-style facilities support tenancy
Strong UOL/SingLand build quality underpins long-term value retention
